events.verdict: Beasley (DET) is firming up when marginal contact occurs as he sets the pick on Moody (GSW) along the perimeter.
Green (GSW) moves his pivot foot on the perimeter.
Santos (GSW) initiates contact with Schröder's (DET) body, which affects his driving shot attempt. This body contact occurs prior to the ball becoming dislodged.
While defending off ball, Beasley (DET) briefly places his arm on Curry's (GSW), the contact does not restrict Curry's FOM as he moves to set the pick on the perimeter.
While defending the transition play, Curry (GSW) briefly grabs and releases Schroder's (DET) arm.
Moody (GSW) moves alongside Cunningham's (DET) path and marginal body contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Schroder (DET) and Curry (GSW) briefly engage and disengage with one another during the screen.
Moody (GSW) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Cunningham (DET) as the steal occurs.
After the turnover, Duren (DET) moves under Green (GSW) as he attempts to corral the pass.
Green (GSW) brings his arm toward Cunningham's (DET) path and marginal contact occurs at the end of Cunningham's (DET) drive.
Schroder (DET) commits a take foul on Curry (GSW) at the end of the game.
Payton II (GSW) quick rest and removes his hand from Beasley's (DET) side as he contests the jump shot attempt.
Cunningham (DET) commits a take foul on Curry (GSW) at the end of the game.
